findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is not set to true) and does not define a key policy, relying on the default policy which grants full access to the account root user and any IAM principals with broad IAM permissions, rather than an explicit least-privilege policy for a sensitive audit trail key.
